newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy's Autostrade sale to be completed by summer.
newsitem.headline: Italy's Autostrade sale to be completed by summer.

text.p: The privatisation of Italian motorway operator Autostrade could be completed by the start of the summer, Treasury minister Carlo Azeglio Ciampi told parliament on Tuesday.
Last month, the Italian cabinet approved a report concerning the criteria for the sell-off of Autostrade by Ciampi, and privatisation was planned by June.

On the planned privatisation of Italian electricity utility ENEL, Ciampi said there was a need to define the new structure of the Italian electricity industry, and what would be the effect on the market of ENEL's privatisation.

The government is hoping to privatise ENEL later this year and a parliamentary commission headed by undersecretary of the industry ministry Umberto Carpi is said to have put forward a plan to make ENEL into a holding company to control the different operating companies within the whole ENEL group.
Ciampi added that the Carpi report will form the basis of the government's plans on privatisation.

He said earlier that the sale of Italy's yellow pages publisher SEAT will be completed by the spring. SEAT was floated off from state-controlled telecoms holding group STET at the beginning of this year with state industrial holding IRI holding a 61 percent stake.
